name: Scofield–Holland Groove
musical_purpose: Rhythmic lift, dyadic voicings, active bass. Never static.
default_ensemble_notes: Guitar dyadic voicings, walking or ostinato bass, light kit

name: Wayne Shorter Narrative
musical_purpose: Sections unfold like scenes. Motivic foreshadowing, interlude between sections.
default_ensemble_notes: Clear sectional divisions, varied textures per section

name: Frisell Atmosphere
musical_purpose: Breathable texture, sparse voicings, suspended harmony.
default_ensemble_notes: Dyads only in sparse passages, long-held pads, space between attacks

name: Counterpoint / Tonality Hybrid
musical_purpose: Two or more independent voices, lyric gravity, no block harmony.

musical_purpose: Dense but clear polyphony, labyrinthine form, inner motion.

musical_purpose: Warm harmonic architecture, singable melody, harmonic surprise.

name: Andrew Hill Harmonic
musical_purpose: Chromatic density, harmonic tension, non-functional colour.

name: Tonality Vault
musical_purpose: Core harmonic framework. Gravitational centre, tension hierarchy.

musical_purpose: Harmonic ambiguity, rhythmic flexibility, axis drift.
